extraction_notes: The datasheet identifies Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd.; the top-level manufacturer preserves the exact job identity hongjiacheng.

Curves were manually digitized from the usable plots on p. 2 without interpolation between plotted readings: Fig. 1 forward current versus forward voltage at Ta = 25 degC and 100 degC, Fig. 2 reverse current versus reverse voltage at Ta = 25 degC and 100 degC, Fig. 3 junction capacitance versus reverse voltage, and Fig. 4 power dissipation versus ambient temperature.
Maximum forward-voltage table values at TA = 25 degC are 250 mV at IF = 0.1 mA, 450 mV at IF = 10 mA, and 1000 mV at IF = 250 mA.
Maximum reverse-current table values at TA = 25 degC are 0.3 uA at VR = 1.5 V, 0.5 uA at VR = 10 V, 1.0 uA at VR = 50 V, and 2.0 uA at VR = 75 V.
Typical capacitance table values at f = 1 MHz and TA = 25 degC are 20 pF at VR = 0 V and 12 pF at VR = 1 V.
Absolute maximum ratings include VRRM = 100 V, VRMS = 70 V, VDC = 100 V, IF(AV) = 0.15 A, IFRM = 0.35 A, IFSM = 0.75 A at t = 8.3 ms half-sine wave, PD = 0.5 W, and Tj = 125 degC.
Schottky majority-carrier device: no minority-carrier storage, TT is zero by construction.
Reverse recovery is not independently specified: the datasheet publishes no trr; reverse_recovery is therefore null in the extracted evidence object.
Reverse breakdown is not modelled: BV and IBV are absent. VRRM = 100 V is an absolute maximum rating, not a measured breakdown voltage.
Package parasitics, self-heating during fitting, and temperature-dependent model parameters are not extracted from this datasheet-only object.
omission_reason: The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery time or reverse-breakdown characteristic; those fields remain null, while the rated reverse-voltage limits are retained in extraction notes.
